references.text: The fundamental law concerning the tithe belonging to the Lord, which the Levites receive from the children of Israel
Regulations regarding the tithe to be given to the Levites since they have no inheritance portion
The tithe shall be given to the Levite because he has no inheritance among the people
The Levites shall bring a tenth of the tithe to the house of the Lord, fulfilling this commandment
Men were appointed to collect the tithes for the Levites according to the law
The tithe given to the Levites, referencing their legally established right
The people brought tithes to the Levites during King Hezekiah's reform
The context explaining that the tithe is the Levites' inheritance as compensation for their service
The continuation explaining that a tenth of the tithe shall be given to the priest Aaron
Reference to the fact that the sons of Levi receive tithes according to the law, and that Abraham gave tithes to Melchizedek
